feeds.title: Seattle Met
feeds.description: Smart. Authoritative. Entertaining. With a bold design, eye-catching photography, and an editorial voice that's at once witty and in-the-know, Seattle Metropolitan is our city's monthly indispensable news, culture, and lifestyle magazine.

feeds.title: Gal Pal
feeds.description: Dive into a world of inspiration with Lisa Marinkovich, your go-to lifestyle expert! Uncover the latest trends in home decorating, design, wellness, family, travel, and fashion on her captivating blog. Lisa, the proud owner of Galpalgoods.com, has curated a unique store just for women. As seen on Q13 in Seattle and featured in the Seattle Times and PNW Magazine, Lisa brings her expertise to life. Join the vibrant Gal Pal community and explore more for a lifestyle that's as fabulous as you are! Click here for a dose of inspiration.

feeds.title: Avec Amber
feeds.description: A Seattle lifestyle blogger sharing fashion trends and globetrotting adventures. Amber is a corporate professional by day and enjoys blogging her style and travels in her personal time.

feeds.title: EatSeattle
feeds.description: EatSeattle is a food & lifestyle publication that showcases Seattle's best places to eat, drink and play.

feeds.title: An Emerald City Life
feeds.description: Hi there! I'm Terumi Pong, and I'm a Seattle blogger and mom of twin boys. I love finding new stories about the places I live in and the places we visit and the products we try out and buy and I post my finds frequently.

feeds.title: Seattleite
feeds.description: With a pulse on the latest in dining, travel, fashion, entertainment, events, and more, Seattleite is the premiere lifestyle resource to deliver the latest news and happenings around the city, showcasing the best that the Puget Sound region and the Pacific Northwest has to offer. Seattleite is the lifestyle news site for Seattle's young professionals who are in-the-know and on-the-go.

feeds.title: Just A Tina Bit
feeds.description: I am Tina. Welcome to my Seattle-based blog, where I share Just A Tina Bit glimpse of my fashion diary! I'm a lover of all things girly chic and an avid believer that being stylish doesn't mean you need to break the bank. Join me on this fashionable journey!

feeds.title: I Am Style-ish
feeds.description: Hi there! I'm Tiffany and I live in Seattle with my husband and our two girls. As a small business owner and mom, I hope to inspire you here with my everyday fashion finds, how to decorate your home and how to live your best life as a busy mom!

feeds.title: Shaylyn Rae
feeds.description: I'm Shay! I'm a designer, corgi lover, and wife blogging about fashion and Architecting buildings in the Northwest corner of the country.

feeds.title: Hey Pretty Thing
feeds.description: I'm Carolyn Yuen Marino. A lifestyle blog about personal style, fashion, food and drink, beauty, hair, makeup, and travel. In addition to blogging, I work full-time as a high school English teacher. For undergrad, I majored in English and Law, and I also received my Master in Teaching from the University of Washington.

feeds.title: WhyToStop
feeds.description: I am Rachna. This blog is based on my personal take on Fashion, beauty tips, travel ideas, lifestyle based posts(pregnancy, health, food, fitness, life, happiness and more). I am not an expert in any such field and have yet to discover my solid niche, henceforth, would love to share whatever I learn from my day to day activities, readings, and life experiences.
